themes: Signs in the horizons and in ourselves
summary_for_children: Fussilat means Explained in Detail. It speaks of how Allah formed the heavens from smoke and the earth, and shows how still earth comes alive with rain.
environment_concept: A world that begins as swirling smoke and settles into heaven and earth, then a still, dusty earth that quivers and grows when rain falls.
architecture_and_scenery: Swirling haze resolving into layered sky, a flat stilled plain, and sprouting hills.

palette.lighting: Hazy diffuse light clearing to blue

areas.name: Heaven as Smoke
areas.description: A sky of drifting smoke that clears into layers.

areas.name: Quivering Growth
areas.description: The plain stirs and sprouts when rain falls.

activities.name: Clear the sky
activities.description: Watch smoke settle into seven layers and lamps of stars (adaptation).
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Rain and growth
activities.description: Bring rain to the stilled earth.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Narration stays with the ayahs and invites reflection on signs in the horizons (41:53).
learning_objectives: Explain rain as a sign of life

status.playable_environment: not built: a shared symbolic setting stands in

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
